subject: Co-sell marketplace demo: finalize agenda & slot for CloudBridge integration
messages:
From: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@cloudbridge.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: co-sell marketplace demo for CloudBridge / Ecosys migration

Hi Diego / team,

Thanks again for the intro. CloudBridge is moving a handful of customers off a legacy stack into an AWS + marketplace deployment (we call the program "Ecosys"). AWS partner management asked us to run a 45–60 minute co-sell demo focused on:
- high-level integration architecture (5–7 mins)
- Redwood-hosted inference economics & latency (15–20 mins)
- implementation checklist + security considerations (10–15 mins)
- Q&A / next steps (10 mins)

Can you and someone from Redwood join the demo the week of Dec 6? Our preferred windows (PST): Dec 7 9:00–10:00, Dec 8 11:00–12:30, Dec 9 14:00–15:00.

Anil (AWS PM) will probably join for the intro and marketplace process questions. I attached a short one-pager with the ask. Also flagging that CloudBridge will want a short network diagram and a runbook for the marketplace setup.

Let me know which slot works and who from Redwood will present the performance/economics section.

Thanks,
Carla Mendez
Sr. Partner Manager, CloudBridge Systems
carla.mendez@cloudbridge.com

Attachment: ecosys-ask-brief.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell marketplace demo for CloudBridge / Ecosys migration

Carla — thanks for the clear brief and the proposed windows.

We can do a 60-minute session and recommend this agenda:
1) Quick intros + context (5) — Diego (Redwood) + Carla / Anil
2) Architecture & marketplace flow (10) — Laura (Redwood) to cover marketplace listing & procurement flow
3) Inference demo + economics (20) — Diego to demo hosted vs dedicated economics + tail latency examples
4) Deployment checklist & security (15) — Sergio to cover VPC/private options, KMS/HSM, audit logs
5) Q&A / next steps (10)

Of your three windows we prefer Dec 8 11:00–12:00 PST (fits our regional team). If you need 12:30 end, we can extend to 12:30. Please confirm timezone and attendee list.

I’m attaching a brief runbook we’ll use as the baseline and a sample network diagram — we’ll finalize after you confirm the slot.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

— Diego Fernandez
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf), sample-sla-matrix.csv (text/csv)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: CloudBridge demo — presenter plan and marketplace sync

Diego / Laura / Marissa — quick note to align before we lock the calendar.

- Laura, you can take the marketplace listing & procurement portion (10 min). Bring the checklist for expected artifacts (SLA, logos, billing contact).
- Diego will lead the demo/economics; please prepare the 2-minute latency video + token-cost slide.
- Marissa, would you be able to join for the first 15 minutes to surface any sales motion follow-ups? If yes, you can own the next-steps slide and HubSpot tasks.

Also recommend we ask Anil (AWS) to say 5 minutes on co-sell expectations and marketplace timelines. I’ll slot the runbook as an attachment in the calendar invite.

If Dec 8 11:00 PST works for CloudBridge, I’ll send the final calendar and include the Drive links.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@cloudbridge.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, anil.kapoor@aws-partners.amazon.com
Date: 2026-12-03T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell marketplace demo for CloudBridge / Ecosys migration — confirmed

Diego / team — confirmed. Dec 8 11:00–12:00 PST works for us. Attendees: Carla (CloudBridge), Victor (CloudBridge Tech lead), Anil (AWS PM), Diego + Laura + Sergio + Marissa (Redwood).

I've attached the network diagram Victor asked to share and added the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ecosys-demo-20261202.

Notes / asks before the demo:
- Please include the runbook PDF in the invite (we have received redwood-runbook-v1.pdf).
- Can Redwood briefly call out any known procurement gotchas for marketplace billing (e.g., invoice vs marketplace charge flows)?
- Victor will share a short environment summary (VPC, peering, expected EIPs) on the thread.

We look forward to the session — thanks for the quick turn.

Best,
Carla

Attachments: cloudbridge-network-diagram.png (image/png)
